levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «أبي» is a bare relation with no name (the compiler's father); the tool holds his identity
«قالا» and «جميعا» mark co-transmitters whose routes meet at the next name, so each level is one list
«رضي الله عنهما» and «عليه السلام» are blessings and are left out
the Imam is written inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator
